description: She wears a blue-teal patterned floor-length coat-dress with a fitted bodice and a low square neckline outlined in gold woven trim. Wide patterned sleeves end around the elbows. Vertical gold-edged panels open down the skirt to reveal a pale ivory underdress. An ivory wrap drapes around her forearms and down both sides. A decorated brown leather belt with round metal discs, hanging charms and tassels secures the waist. Small turquoise and gold fastenings ornament the front. Gold-patterned shoes show beneath the hem. There is no headgear, armor or weapon.
